pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal dark regions exhibiting complex, star-like edge gradients with sharp angularity on the lateral flank, transitioning to broader, more rounded geometries on the lower neck.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous system of light-colored negative space with varying pixel thickness; featuring wide pathways on the ventral neck and a high-density lattice of narrow intersections on the shoulder and flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A continuous, low-amplitude serrated silhouette of dark mane fibers extending along the dorsal line of the neck, exhibiting high-frequency pixel jaggedness against the background.

other_distinctive_markers: Partial visibility of a secondary giraffe specimen (head and upper neck) located in the background, occluded by the primary subject's neck.
